meaning: Multi-turn pairwise constraint contextuality benchmark before code generation across 5 model families: Phase 1 separates single-variable overlap drift across turns (L = 0, E_g = 0, Delta_E = 0), Phase 2 separates no-signaling hollow-triangle contextuality on anti-correlated pairwise commitments (pA = pB = pC = 1/2, qAB = qBC = qCA = 0, alpha_min = 0 > -1/2 = alpha_max -> L = 1, E_g = 0, Delta_E = -1), and Phase 3 verifies pre-generation sheaf-gated reconciliation of Turn 3 to qCA = 1/2 (alpha_min = alpha_max = 0, unique global section d(0,1,0) = d(1,0,1) = 1/2 -> L = 1, E_g = 1, Delta_E = 0).
